items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, shit, she had a great impact on me.

ctx.x: Even in terms of the impact they have on you?

Oh, shit, she had a great impact on me. Number one, during that time she was the only one you could understand the lyrics. Even Sarah, you know, Sarah would slur those lyrics sometimes. What you saying, baby? You know. But Dinah was there. She was hot stuff.
And we talked about Carmen, unless there‘s anything else.
